public_definitions: Goal: Review the mountain snowpack temperature dashboard for the 2005-2015 review period, determine whether the full-period change requires substantial-change follow-up, then submit the appropriate routing decision.
Comparison Scope: Full-period mountain snowpack temperature change (2005-2015).
Routing Criterion: Whether the full-period mountain snowpack temperature change requires substantial-change follow-up.
Option 1: Route the 2005 to 2015 mountain snowpack temperature change to substantial-change follow-up
Option 2: Keep the 2005 to 2015 mountain snowpack temperature change on routine monitoring for ordinary variation
Option 3: Route the mountain snowpack temperature record to archive and background filing
uncertain: The specific numerical threshold for 'substantial-change' is not provided in the image or text; it must be inferred from the magnitude of the change shown.
The data point for the year 2011 is missing from the x-axis labels and has no corresponding data point label, although the line connects 2010 and 2012.
